faqs.q: Where is Salik Fast Food located?
faqs.a: Salik Fast Food is located in Wah Model Town, Wah Cantt.

faqs.q: What food does Salik Fast Food offer?
faqs.a: The menu covers pizza and special pizza, zinger and grill burgers, chicken shawarma, sandwiches, fries, hot wings, chicken nuggets, special items and combo deals.

faqs.q: Does Salik Fast Food deliver in Wah Cantt?
faqs.a: Yes — home delivery is available in nearby areas of Wah Cantt. Minimum order is Rs. 500 and the delivery fee is Rs. 100.
Please call to confirm today's timings — call 0309-5369472.

faqs.q: How can I contact Salik Fast Food?
faqs.a: Call 0309-5369472, or send your order on WhatsApp.

faqs.q: Where can I see the Salik Fast Food menu and prices?
faqs.a: The full menu with current prices is on this website — every category has its own tab with item photos and prices.

reviews.name: Usman Tariq
reviews.comment: Hands down the best crown crust pizza in Wah Cantt! Cheese pull was insane and the crust was loaded with kabab pieces. Delivered piping hot in 30 minutes to Model Town Phase 1.

reviews.name: Dr. Ayesha Siddiqui
reviews.comment: Their Zinger patty is so crispy and juicy, beats international brands in Wah. The garlic mayo sauce is top tier. Will definitely be our regular weekend family order!

reviews.name: Hamza Malik
reviews.comment: Incredible value for money. Deal 3 easily fed four of us with plenty left over. Ordering directly on their website was super smooth and received instant WhatsApp confirmation.

reviews.name: Zainab Bibi
reviews.comment: Best shawarma in town! Proper pita bread, packed with grilled chicken and pickling veggies without too much oily mayo. Fresh, clean, and delivered fast.

reviews.name: Bilal Ahmed
reviews.comment: Broast was super crunchy outside and tender inside, not oily at all. The loaded fries with melted cheese and chipotle sauce were fantastic. 10/10 recommended for Wah foodies.

reviews.name: Sana Farooq
reviews.comment: If you like creamy, rich desi flavors on a pizza, their Malai Boti pizza is unbeatable. Soft crust, generous chicken chunks, and arrived steam-hot. Customer service is 10/10!

reviews.name: Naveed Akhtar
reviews.comment: Ordered for a family get-together. Everything from the pizzas to the burgers and fries was fresh and perfectly packed. Very courteous delivery rider.

reviews.name: Kashif Mehmood
reviews.comment: Authentic taste and fresh dough made daily. Salik Fast Food has become our go-to late night hunger spot in Wah. Keep up the high standard!
